children: Twist Bioscience shares advanced after the company said it signed a deal with Eli Lilly's drug discovery platform Lilly TuneLab.
The stock was up 5% to $144.90 Wednesday. Shares have more than quadrupled over the past year.

TuneLab offers access to artificial intelligence and machine learning models to help with drug discovery. Participating companies can use TuneLab's prediction models to more rapidly select candidate molecules.
Through the partnership, users will be able to order antibody services from Twist using TuneLab preferred Twist protocols to generate wet lab data.
